capabilities: generate tags for the whole note or a selected text via OpenAI
insert generated tags into frontmatter, creating it if missing
preview suggested tags and accept or reject each one
format tags as kebab-case, snake_case, camelCase, PascalCase, and others
run in demo mode without an API key
extras: Demo mode is enabled by default so the plugin works before configuring an API key. Full mode uses the paid OpenAI API; the README suggests setting a monthly spending limit (e.g. 1-2 USD) and notes GPT 3.5 is cheap. Plugin is in beta and the author invites bug reports via GitHub issues, a feedback form, email, or X/Twitter.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically suggest tags for a note, so users often forget tags or don't know which ones to use.
summary: AI tag generator that sends a note or selection to OpenAI and inserts suggested tags into the note's frontmatter.
